16.0: Quiet in class, loud at lunch. I copied math from Irina and she copied English from me. I cried once over a B and hid it in a lunchbox for a week.

36.0: Twenty minutes early, always, sitting in the car, eating the sandwich I made for later. You are ten minutes late and you always arrive laughing. I am starting to see the point.

64.0: Shoes. The length of everything. And a concert two towns away that I went to anyway. Your grandmother knew. She had left money in my coat.

94.0: You were six. I had a headache, and you turned off every light in the house and put a blanket on the dog so he would not make noise. I have never felt so looked after.

17.0: I talk too much in history. I am not sorry, it is a good class.

37.0: Ten minutes late. But I bring the fun.

65.0: My phone. My room. Whether it is cold outside. It is never cold outside.

95.0: You drove back for my stuffed rabbit. Two hours. You said it was on the way.

text.4: How to Use This Journal 1 One of you answers a question, then leaves the journal where the other will find it. 2 Answer on your own page. This is just between the two of you. Nobody else needs to read it. 4
